name: Emberwisp the Ruddy Cat
blurb: Emberwisp, a ruddy-orange kitten with a softly ticked fluffy coat, tall ears and a bushy fox-like tail, watches the garden sparrows.

name: Inkstache the Bicolor Cat
blurb: Inkstache, a white cat with a black cap over its ears, a few black patches and a black moustache smudge under its nose, eyes beetles.

name: Tassel the Tufted Tabby Cat
blurb: Tassel, a big fluffy brown tabby with a white muzzle and bib, a pink nose and long ear tufts, pads up to sniff each garden visitor.
